description: TypeScript patterns and pitfalls for monorepo development

patterns.title: Workspace package naming convention
patterns.problem: Need consistent naming for internal packages

patterns.title: Shared TypeScript config extension
patterns.solution: Create packages/config/tsconfig.base.json and extend it in each package

patterns.title: Bun workspace catalog for version management
patterns.problem: Keeping dependency versions in sync across packages
patterns.solution: Use workspaces.catalog in root package.json, reference with "catalog:" in packages

pitfalls.title: TanStack Router routeTree.gen.ts not found
pitfalls.error: Cannot find module './routeTree.gen' or its corresponding type declarations
pitfalls.cause: Route tree file is auto-generated on first build/dev run
pitfalls.prevention: Run 'vite build' or 'vite dev' once before 'tsc --noEmit'

pitfalls.title: Vite import.meta.env type casting
pitfalls.cause: Vite's import.meta.env needs type assertion for @t3-oss/env-core
pitfalls.prevention: Use (import.meta as any).env or add proper Vite client types
